observations: Photo shows several stacked solar panels with aluminum frames, resting on their edges against a wall/cart.
A visible watermark reads 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' across the panels, likely a reseller/photo watermark, not a manufacturer brand on the panel itself.
No visible manufacturer label, wattage sticker, cell-count marking, or model plate readable on any panel.
Panels appear to have visible wear/dust consistent with used condition; a person's leg and a basket are visible in the background, suggesting an outdoor or warehouse setting.
Bottom of image shows camera metadata overlay ('CAMON 30', '23mm f/1.88 1/135s ISO50') from the phone used to take the photo, not panel data.

claims.evidence: No wattage label or spec sticker visible on any panel in photo 0.
Cell count cannot be confirmed; panels are angled and partly overlapping, cells not countable clearly.
No shipping label, customs tag, or country-of-origin marking visible.

claims.claim: Used solar panel 'built to serve you' (implying full working condition)
claims.evidence: No output test, multimeter reading, or performance demonstration shown.

risks.risk: Actual power output may be far lower than claimed 650W due to age, micro-cracks, or degraded cells.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the manufacturer's rating label/sticker on the back of each panel, plus a multimeter or load-test video showing voltage/current under sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/lower-wattage used panel, not as 650W

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage such as hairline cracks, delamination, or hotspots not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each panel's full surface in good light, plus back-side photo showing junction box and wiring condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition-unknown, assume moderate wear/damage risk

risks.risk: Panel may not be functioning at all (no load test shown).
risks.proof: Video of panel connected to a load or multimeter showing live voltage/current output in sunlight.

risks.risk: Frame, glass, or junction box missing or damaged, affecting installability.
risks.proof: Photo of each panel's back side showing junction box, cables, and frame corners.

risks.risk: Mismatch between number of panels shown and quantity being sold.
risks.proof: Seller to confirm exact count and show all units laid flat individually.
risks.if_unproven: priced based on minimum visible quantity only

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating label/sticker on the back of each panel showing wattage, voltage, and cell count.
Video of the panel connected to a multimeter or small load showing live voltage/current output under sunlight.
Clear photos of each panel's full front and back, including junction box and cable condition.
Confirmation of total quantity of panels being sold, with each one laid flat and separately photographed.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used solar panel, but wattage, cell count, origin, and working condition are all unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified output, unverified function) until the seller provides a label close-up and a load-test video.
